questions.question: A 16-bit instruction has 8 distinct instruction types and 8 registers. Each instruction has exactly 2 register operands. How many bits remain for an immediate operand (if any)?
questions.solutionApproach: opcode bits = ⌈log2(8)⌉=3. register bits per operand = ⌈log2(8)⌉=3, ×2 operands = 6. Remaining = 16-3-6 = 7.

questions.question: MOV A,5; MOV B,3; ADD A,B; SUB B,A  — what are the final values of A and B (assume ADD A,B means A=A+B; SUB B,A means B=B-A)?
A loop runs 10 times. Loop body: LOAD(2 cycles), ADD(1 cycle), STORE(2 cycles). Plus 1 setup instruction (1 cycle) before the loop. Total cycles?
questions.solutionApproach: Loop body per iteration = 2+1+2=5 cycles. 10 iterations = 50. Plus setup 1. Total = 51.
